title: Golden set - Epic 1 Search and Availability

provenance.authoredBy: DRAFT seeded by Devin for the PoC - must be reviewed, corrected or replaced by the QE lead before Gate 1
provenance.note: The PoC requires 12-15 human-authored cases. Replace this file (or paste a new set on the Compare tab) with the QE team's own cases; the comparison is recomputed from whatever set is present.

cases.title: Guest finds hotels for a valid Paris stay
steps: Type Paris, pick dates a month ahead for 3 nights, 1 room, 2 adults
cases.expected: Results page opens with a count of hotels found and hotel cards

cases.title: Search criteria shown on results and can be edited
cases.expected: Summary shows Paris and the dates; the form opens again with Paris filled in and editable

cases.title: Check-in yesterday is blocked
steps: Set check-in to yesterday, check-out in two days
cases.expected: Error under check-in says the date cannot be in the past; no results shown

cases.title: Same-day check-out is blocked
cases.expected: Error under check-out says it must be after the check-in date

cases.title: Empty mandatory fields are blocked
cases.expected: Error summary appears and destination says it is required

cases.title: City with no inventory explains there is nothing available
cases.expected: Message says no hotels match and no available inventory was found; Modify search lets the guest change criteria

cases.title: Too many children for one room is blocked
cases.expected: Children field says a room holds up to 3 children

cases.title: Mandatory fields are marked
cases.expected: Destination, check-in, check-out, rooms and adults carry a required marker; a Required field legend is shown

cases.title: Five adults in one room gets a field message
cases.expected: Adults field explains a room holds up to 4 adults

cases.title: Server rejects a 31-night stay the browser lets through
cases.expected: Server message on check-out says stays are limited to 30 nights

cases.title: Errors are announced to screen readers
cases.expected: An alert region announces the errors and invalid fields are flagged and described by their message

cases.title: No results offers ways to change the search
cases.expected: Change dates, change occupancy and change destination options are shown; change dates puts focus on check-in

cases.title: Availability outage shows a friendly error with retry
cases.expected: Plain message that the search could not be completed, no error codes, and a Try again button

cases.title: Double-clicking search runs one search
cases.expected: One results list with a single search reference
